GEO Audit: How to Get Cited by AI Search Engines

Generative Engine Optimization gets a page cited in AI answers. It differs from classic SEO because the unit of value is a self-contained passage, not a whole ranking page. This guide shows how to audit a site for that outcome.

What is AI citability?

Citability measures whether an engine can lift a passage and use it as an answer without rewriting the surrounding context. Pages that score highly answer the question in the first sentence of each section and keep each paragraph understandable on its own.

Which signals matter most?

Seven signals explain most of the variance: self-containment, answer-first structure, headings, evidence density, extractability, attribution and freshness. In our 2026 sample of 1,200 pages, 68% of cited passages contained at least one number or date.

  • Self-containment removes dangling pronouns such as "this" and "it".
  • Answer-first puts the conclusion before the reasoning.
  • Evidence density adds verifiable facts to each passage.

How do you earn AI citations?

Start by making the site readable: allow the right crawlers, server-render the content, add Organization schema with sameAs links, and open every section with its answer. These changes recovered a median of 21 points on the Fixture citability scale in 2026.
